content.short: Extra Finance is a leveraged yield farming and lending protocol built on the Optimism and Base networks.
content.description: Extra Finance is an advanced decentralized finance protocol designed to maximize capital efficiency through leveraged yield farming and lending. Operating on Optimism and Base, the platform enables users to deposit single or dual assets into various liquidity pools and multiply their yields using borrowed capital. With customizable leverage strategies, auto-compounding features, and rigorous risk management mechanisms, it offers a powerful environment for DeFi participants.
